High-Speed HDR Video Reconstruction using Hybrid Intensity Frames and Events 
IIT-Madras, India            [slides] July, 2021 -  April, 2022 
This project aims to prove the efficiency of event-based interpolation as compared to other non-event based techniques for 
efficient HDR video reconstruction.  
We simulated the event data and used the techniques of deep learning for event-based interpolation and HDR 
reconstruction. 
Curriculum learning in Neural Networks, 
IIT Madras, India             [report] Jan, 2020 -  March, 2020 
 We demonstrated the concept of curriculum learning on neural networks, where we trained a network initially on the 
custom-made lines dataset and used their initial layer weights as the initialization for the training on characters dataset. 
 We could clearly observe that learning from scratch was much slower as compared to learning from these pre-trained weights. 
Ventilator Assignment Problem 
Freelance                           [report]                                                                   December, 2020 
 Given patient level data with their characteristics and another data containing time series biometric information of the 
patients, we aim to reduce patient mortality by identifying high risk patients based on the available data and devoting the 
limited ventilators to them. 
 Firstly, I combined the two data and had done necessary feature engineering, exploratory data analysis and based on 
feature importance, I had added extra features to give it as an input to various tree-based classifiers. It was found that 
the gradient boosting technique(Catboost) was found to give better results among all the classifiers.
